cases.name: Pick the Brain prefix
cases.text: Target opponent reveals their hand. You choose a nonland card from it and exile that card.

cases.name: Reap Intellect prefix
cases.text: Target opponent reveals their hand. You choose up to X nonland cards from it and exile them.

cases.name: Wrong owner refusal
cases.text: Target opponent reveals their hand. You choose a nonland card from your hand and exile that card.

cases.name: Pick the Brain complete
cases.text:
Target opponent reveals their hand. You choose a nonland card from it and exile that card.
If there are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard, search that player's graveyard, hand, and library for any number of cards with the same name as the exiled card, exile those cards, then that player shuffles.

cases.name: Pick the Brain
cases.text:
Target opponent reveals their hand. You choose a noncreature card from it and exile that card.
If there are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard, search that player's graveyard, hand, and library for any number of cards with the same name as the exiled card, exile those cards, then that player shuffles.

cases.name: Pick the Brain
cases.text:
Target opponent reveals their hand. You choose a nonland card from it and exile that card.
If there are three or more card types among cards in your graveyard, search that player's graveyard, hand, and library for any number of cards with the same name as the exiled card, exile those cards, then that player shuffles.
